ios.s1: Keep the watch close to the iPhone with Bluetooth on. If it is still connected to another phone, disconnect it there first. It shows up in the list below.
ios.s2: Unbind it from Huawei Health first, or the watch will refuse this app.
ios.s3: On the first connect, keep the watch awake, accept the prompt on its screen, then tap Pair on the iPhone.

android.s1: Unbind the watch from Huawei Health first, or the watch will refuse this app.
android.s2: Pair it in Android Bluetooth settings, or tap "Scan nearby devices" below to find it.
android.s3: On the first connect, keep the watch awake and accept the prompt on its screen.

hint.busy: Could not connect to the watch. If it is still connected to another phone or app (Huawei Health, or JoyoFit on another phone), disconnect it there first. Keep the watch awake and close to this phone, then tap Retry.
hint.noWatchIos: Watch not found. If it is still connected to another phone, disconnect it there first. Make sure the watch is on and close to this phone, then tap Refresh.
hint.noWatchScan: No watch found nearby. If it is still connected to another phone or app (Huawei Health, or JoyoFit on another phone), disconnect it there first. Make sure the watch is on and close to this phone, then scan again.

silent.short: The watch connected over Bluetooth but does not answer. What to try is on the Watch tab.
silent.title: The watch connected but does not answer
silent.intro: JoyoFit reached the watch over Bluetooth, but the watch did not reply to the first request. Usually another app or phone is using it. Try these one at a time, then tap Retry.

step.release: Disconnect the watch from Huawei Health and from any other phone, then close that app completely.
step.forgetIos: On the iPhone, open Settings > Bluetooth, tap the (i) icon next to the watch, then choose Forget This Device.
step.restart: Restart the watch, wait until its screen is fully on, then bring it close to the phone.
step.bluetooth: Turn the phone's Bluetooth off and on again, then try to connect.

silent.reportHelp: If it still fails, send a report. It holds the latest Bluetooth log, without Bluetooth addresses or the serial number.

bonded.forgetMessage: This drops the stored auth key for this watch. The next connect is a first-time bind and has to be confirmed on the watch. Android Bluetooth pairing is not touched.
bonded.systemConnected: Already connected to this iPhone. Tap Connect to use it here.
bonded.notInReach: Not in reach. If it is on another phone, disconnect it there first.

bind.title: Pair this watch with this phone?

find.unsupported: This watch did not report find-device support.

support.title: Help support your watch
support.intro: JoyoFit is tested on the Huawei Watch Fit 4 Pro. Other Huawei and Honor watches are experimental. If something does not work, connect once, then send a report. It lists what your watch answered on its last connect, without Bluetooth addresses or the serial number.
support.copied: The full report is on your clipboard. On GitHub, say what works and what does not, then paste the report into the Log field.

smart.title: Smart alarm
smart.about: Wakes you at a light moment of sleep within the chosen window before the time. The watch keeps one smart alarm and cannot delete it, only switch it off.

faces.installAbout:
Make faces in Huawei Theme Studio Pro and export them as .hwt files. Make them for your watch's screen size. A face made for another screen is refused before it is sent.

Whether the watch accepts a face that Huawei did not sign is not known. If it refuses, the exact status code it returned is shown here and in the log.
faces.installAboutSized:
Make faces in Huawei Theme Studio Pro and export them as .hwt files. This watch's screen is {{width}} x {{height}} px. A face made for another screen is refused before it is sent.

Whether the watch accepts a face that Huawei did not sign is not known. If it refuses, the exact status code it returned is shown here and in the log.
